- Build a complete, playable pixel-art arcade fighting game inspired by Mortal Kombat and Street Fighter.

- Playable game; no clarifying questions.

- Built an original game branded “RIFT//CLASH” with original fighters and visuals rather than using copyrighted characters.

- Created `index.html` with a responsive pixel-art fighting game, CPU opponent, rounds, health and energy meters, sound toggle, and touch controls.
- JavaScript syntax checked successfully before the user’s latest request.

### Active
- Expand gameplay and controls to implement six attack strengths/types, jump, block, grapple, special, and finishing move.
- Update desktop and touch control hints/buttons to match implemented actions.

- (none)

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Expand RIFT//CLASH with 15 selectable Mortal Kombat and Street Fighter characters, show their names in the title screen and HUD, and add more visual detail to the fighters.

## Requirements
- Include 15 randomly selected characters drawn from both franchises.
- Make fighter choices selectable and visible to players.

## Decisions
- Use title-screen selection: Q/E cycles the player, A/D cycles the CPU; Enter starts the fight.
- Show selected fighter names on the title screen and above each fighter’s HUD.
- Add distinct appearance details for each character.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added a randomized 15-character roster split between Mortal Kombat and Street Fighter.
- Added keyboard title-screen selection, visible selected names, and fighter names in the HUD.
- Added pointer-based selection on the title canvas.

### Active
- Integrate the newly added per-character appearance data into fighter rendering so the fighters look distinct.
- Validate selection, gameplay, round resets, and script syntax.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect `index.html` and connect `characterLooks` to `drawFighter`; the existing renderer still uses generic palettes.
2. Extract the inline script and run `node --check`.
3. Test character selection, starting/rematching, and name/appearance updates in the HUD and gameplay.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game code, roster, character selection, per-character appearance data, renderer, and HUD.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- `characterLooks` was added with distinct color and feature data for all 30 roster characters, but is not yet used by `drawFighter`.
- The mobile title-screen pointer selection chooses fighters by tapping the left/right canvas areas; touch-control buttons no longer auto-start the fight.

## Objective
- Build RIFT//CLASH into an all-time classic with persistent achievements ranging from small milestones to major accomplishments.
- Test the achievement experience, validate the code, and publish the improvement for player feedback.

## Requirements
- Implement persistent achievements and test unlock conditions, display, and persistence.
- Run JavaScript syntax validation and `git diff --check`.
- Commit and push the improvement to GitHub `main`.
- Welcome criticism and recommendations as opportunities to improve the game.

## Decisions
- Achievements and player progress are stored in localStorage under `rift-clash-achievements`.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added 13 achievement definitions, profile load/save logic, and tracking for matches, hits/combos, rounds won, special moves, finishers, match wins, clean sweeps, and distinct winning fighters.
- Added an Achievements button with an unlocked count.
- Added match completion and round-win tracking hooks in `index.html`.

### Active
- Implement the achievement list/modal display and unlock notifications; the UI state variables exist, but no modal or toast is displayed yet.
- Test achievement unlock conditions, display, and reload persistence.
- Run syntax validation and `git diff --check`, then commit and push to GitHub `main`.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add achievement list/modal and unlock notification rendering.
2. Test unlock conditions, display, and persistence across reloads.
3. Run JavaScript syntax validation and `git diff --check`.
4. Commit and push the improvement to GitHub `main`.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Single-file game implementation; achievement definitions, persistence, tracking, UI, and gameplay hooks.

## Important Context
- Achievement changes are uncommitted and have not yet been validated or published.
- The previous published build was pushed to GitHub `main` at commit `c8a05349354d1024444fe9559ad7dc59749a1fc7`.
- Playable project: https://go.ondev.store/d88lamprecht-lab/PlayGround.
